source_title: Supervisors at BHP's Escondida mine in Chile reject offer, paving the way for a strike
quote: Supervisors at Chile's Escondida copper mine, the world's largest, rejected a collective contract offer on Wednesday, paving the way for a potential strike at the site.

source_title: Supervisors at BHP's Escondida mine in Chile reject offer, paving the way for a strike
quote: Last week, the 1,020-member union received the final proposal and urged its members to reject it in the vote.

source_title: Supervisors at BHP's Escondida mine in Chile reject offer, paving the way for a strike
quote: Under Chilean law, the parties must now enter a mandatory five-day government-led mediation process, which can be extended by mutual agreement for another five days, before a work stoppage can legally begin.

source_title: Supervisors at BHP's Escondida mine in Chile reject offer, paving the way for a strike
quote: "The company's offer demonstrated a complete disregard for the contribution made by supervisors and staff to the production and multi-billion-dollar profits of the world's largest copper mine," the union said in a statement, adding that 95% of participating members voted in favor of strike action.

source_title: S Korea Sept petrochemical export value up 5%; volumes down 19%
quote: By volume, petrochemical exports in September fell by 19.1% year on year to 2.8 million tonnes, according to data from the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources (MOTIR) on Thursday.

source_title: S Korea Sept petrochemical export value up 5%; volumes down 19%
quote: South Korea's petrochemical exports in September rose by 5.1% year on year to $3.9 billion on higher prices but volumes continued to fall amid low production.

source_title: Pemex crude oil exports fall 45% in August amid refining push
quote: Petroleos Mexicanos reported a 45% decline in crude oil exports for August compared to the same month last year, with shipments dropping to 275,737 barrels per day.

source_title: Pemex crude oil exports fall 45% in August amid refining push
quote: The company processed 1.2 million barrels per day at its six refineries, marking a 15% increase from August 2025.

source_title: Pemex crude oil exports fall 45% in August amid refining push
quote: The higher domestic fuel production allowed Pemex to reduce gasoline imports by 24% and diesel imports by 26%.
